## What's new

**Fix: Toggle Vencord closed Discord and it didn't come back**
- Discord closes every program it started when it quits, and that included the helper that swaps the files and opens Discord again. The helper is now started by Windows itself, so it keeps running after Discord closes.
- If Windows can't start the helper, Discord now stays open and nothing changes.

If it happened to you: open the **Discord + Vencord** shortcut on your desktop, or run the installer at https://friendsinvoice.sarhsoft.com again.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord, or the installer at https://friendsinvoice.sarhsoft.com. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.24.1.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
